mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 60 trading days signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the horizon, or the 60-day rolling IC <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.2% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of labor market tightening and reduced inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.2%, or IC <0.03 over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing demand (HOUST) proxies signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through expanded corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite both proxies rising, or IC <0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by FEDFUNDS <4.0% and UNRATE <3.5%, a further decline in FEDFUNDS below 3.8% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged easing.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite FEDFUNDS declining below 3.8% in the regime, or IC <0.03 over the 20d horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over the next 5 trading days signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise sufficiently to trigger the 5d positive return, or IC <0.05 over the 5d window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting market optimism about labor market strength and economic resilience.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite PAYEMS crossing the threshold, or IC <0.03 over 60d.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and industrial demand (RSAFS) proxies signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through expanded corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite both proxies rising, or IC <0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle regime (FEDFUNDS >4.5%), a further rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate higher interest rates dampening growth.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.0% in the tightening regime, or IC >0.03 over the 20d horizon.
